gloss: already read; read (of a message or document)

definitions.explanation: Indicates that something (a book, message, email, or document) has already been read. Used both for physical reading and digital read-receipt status in apps such as LINE.

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}はもう{読|よ}み{済|ず}みだ。
{読|よ}み{済|ず}みのメールをフォルダに{移動|いどう}した。
examples.english: I moved the emails I had already read to a folder.

examples.japanese: LINEのメッセージが{読|よ}み{済|ず}みになっているのに{返信|へんじ}が{来|こ}ない。
examples.english: The LINE message shows as read, but no reply has come.

notes:
The {済|す}み component comes from {済|す}む (to be done, to be finished). Common in both physical contexts (books, documents) and digital messaging.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {読|よ}み{済|ず}みにする: to mark as read
- {読|よ}み{済|ず}みのメール: read emails
- {未読|みどく} (unread) ↔ {読|よ}み{済|ず}み (read) — common contrast in email/message apps

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {既読|きどく}: read (especially in LINE context); same meaning but shorter; used in {既読|きどく}スルー (seen but no reply)
- {未読|みどく}: unread — the opposite
